ITA-1.9.4.1 guṇaḥ गुणः
Property, quality or trait
Attribute, property or quality of a substance; it forms an inseparable entity with substance (dravya); quality is devoid of any action on its own, although it is responsible for action through dravya.

.1 guṇaḥ गुणः
Property, quality or attribute
Property, quality or attribute

ITA-1.9.2.3 guṇa-viśeṣaḥ गुण-विशेषः
Dissimilarity at the level of quality
Qualities with opposing actions which result in one of them being depleted, e.g. the pacification of vata with usage of sesame oil owing to its opposite qualities.

ITA-1.9.1.3 guṇa-sāmānyam गुण-सामान्यम्
Similarity at the level of qualities or properties
Quality exists in substance. This term denotes the similarity in quality exhibited by different substances, e.g. semen and milk.
